name: Qualifications Of An Elder
overview: Scripture reveals that elders are appointed as overseers and shepherds of the church, entrusted with the responsibility to care for God's flock, which He purchased with His own blood (Acts 20:28). The early church leaders ordained elders through prayer and fasting to establish order in every congregation (Acts 14:23; Titus 1:5). Qualifications for elders include being blameless, faithful in marriage, and having well-behaved children, underscoring the importance of personal integrity and family leadership (Titus 1:6). These roles align with the broader gifting of pastors and teachers given by Christ to equip the church for service and growth (Ephesians 4:11).
